dim(counts)
str(samples)

#2a:
rownames(samples) <- samples$run
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(counts),colData = samples, design = ~ group)
levels(dds$group)
dds$group <- factor(dds$group, levels = c("untrt","trt"))
levels(dds$group)
#2b:
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >=10) >=2
dds <- dds[keep, ]
nrow(dds)
#2c:
vsd <- vst(dds, blind =TRUE)
dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
p_pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup ="group")
p_pca
ggsave("plots/PCA.png", p_pca, width =7, height =5, dpi=300)
#variance of PC1 : 42% and variance of PC2 : 26% (the percentages on the axes show how much of the variation each axis explains)
#Yes, treated and untreated samples got separated separate from each other (along y-axis)

#3a:
dds <- DESeq(dds)
write.csv(counts(dds, normalized =TRUE),"results/normalized_counts.csv", quote =FALSE)
#3b:
numerator <-"trt"
denominator <-"untrt"
comparison <- paste0(numerator,"_vs_", denominator)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("group","trt", "untrt"))
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
res_df$status <-"Not significant"
res_df$status[res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange >= 1] <-"Up"
res_df$status[res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange <= -1] <-"Down"
table(res_df$status)
#Upregulated = 465
#Downregulated = 388
#3c:
degs <- subset(res_df, status %in% c("Up","Down"))
nrow(degs)
head(degs)
write.csv(res_df,paste0("results/",comparison,"_all_genes.csv"), row.names =FALSE)
write.csv(degs, paste0("results/",comparison,"_DEGs.csv"),row.names =FALSE)
deg_table <- read.csv(paste0("results/",comparison,"_DEGs.csv"))
head(deg_table)
#3d:
#A gene has log2FC=3 indicates that the numerator sample has 3 fold times higher gene expression than the denominator sample 
#4a:
volcano_data <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj), ]
p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = status)) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up"="firebrick","Down"="steelblue","Not significant"="grey70")) + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1), linetype ="dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype="dashed")+ 
    labs(title = "trt_vs_untrt", x ="log2 fold change", y="-log10 adjusted p-value") + 
    theme_bw()
ggsave(paste0("plots/volcano_", comparison,".png"),p_volcano, width =6, height =5, dpi =300)
p_volcano
#Upregulated genes are represented as red and doenregulated genes are represented as blue. It explains the genes expression and its statistical significance. 
#The strongest hits are the highest andfurthest from the centre.
